name: v27-03-no-group-solo-blob
objective: v2.7 plan 03 live row (D7), no model. A one-on-one chat that holds a story blob written before stories were group-only shows the make-a-group card and nothing else runs: no audit, no injection in a dry-run prompt, no HUD; selecting a story there is refused; the card's button (confirmed) makes a group of the story's own cast, binds it to the story and opens it, and the new group chat plays the story. The blob is stamped with the version this build writes, read from the sandbox group chat's own blob after the import (a literal goes stale on every bump). The dry-run leak check fails when no request was captured, and its needles are the headers the runtime's blocks really carry (private knowledge, memory tiers, guidance, cast notes, the start checkpoint's objective). The step that lands in the new group adopts its chat (adoptsNewChat other-group); the fixture's cleanup block removes the binding (saved through ST's saveSettings with the /api/settings/save answer observed), deletes the created group after ST's 1 s group-save debounce and reads the deletion back. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-03-no-group-solo-blob.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'.

requires.why: the sun-ruins cast (DM Narrator, Arin, Ponticius, Luke) must exist as cards for the make-a-group button to create a full group; no model call is made

steps.eval: const deadline = Date.now() + 10000; let version = null; while (Date.now() < deadline) { version = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator?.version; if (typeof version === 'number') break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } if (typeof version !== 'number') throw new Error('the sandbox group chat holds no stamped story blob after the import, so the build\'s blob version is unknown'); globalThis.__v2703blob = { version }; return globalThis.__v2703blob;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (ctx.groupId) throw new Error('solo_chat did not leave the group'); if (rt.getSnapshot().ready) throw new Error('a story plays in a one-on-one chat with nothing selected'); if (rt.getSnapshot().noGroup) throw new Error('an ordinary one-on-one chat shows the make-a-group card'); globalThis.__v2703 = { soloChat: ctx.chatId, auditsBefore: rt.getExtractionAudits().length }; return globalThis.__v2703;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const version = globalThis.__v2703blob?.version; if (typeof version !== 'number') throw new Error('the blob version was not read from the group chat'); ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator = { version, chatId: ctx.chatId, selectedStoryId: 'sun-ruins', stories: {} }; await ctx.saveMetadata?.(); await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.loadSelectedFromChat(); const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const result = { ready: snapshot.ready, noGroup: snapshot.noGroup, status: snapshot.status }; if (snapshot.ready) throw new Error(`the solo story blob loaded a story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (snapshot.noGroup?.storyId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the make-a-group card does not name the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const NEEDLES = ["Your private knowledge (stay in character","[Established facts","[Details from this session]","[Recent events]","[Earlier scenes]","Author's private direction for this scene","What the cast privately holds","Get close to the guild's job board to see available missions."]; const blocks = Object.keys(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter((key) => key.startsWith('story_orchestrator')).filter((key) => SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts[key]?.value); if (blocks.length) throw new Error(`a one-on-one chat holds story prompt blocks: ${blocks.join(', ')}`); if (document.querySelector('#so-hud')) throw new Error('the HUD shows in a one-on-one chat'); const sent = []; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const listener = (data) => sent.push(JSON.stringify(data)); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); try { await ctx.generate('normal', {}, true); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, listener); } if (!sent.length) throw new Error('the dry run captured no request at GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, so the leak check measured nothing'); const leaked = NEEDLES.filter((needle) => sent.some((body) => body.includes(JSON.stringify(needle).slice(1, -1)))); if (leaked.length) throw new Error(`the dry-run request carries a story injection: ${JSON.stringify(leaked)}`); return { dryRuns: sent.length, needles: NEEDLES.length, leaked };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const selected = await rt.selectStory('sun-ruins'); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (selected || snapshot.ready) throw new Error('selecting a story in a one-on-one chat was not refused'); if (!String(snapshot.status).includes('Stories play in group chats')) throw new Error(`the refusal does not name the fix: ${snapshot.status}`); if (rt.getExtractionAudits().length !== globalThis.__v2703.auditsBefore) throw new Error('an extraction read ran in a one-on-one chat'); return { refused: true, status: snapshot.status };

const button = document.querySelector('#so-make-group-drawer [data-so="make-group-button"]'); if (!button) throw new Error('the drawer shows no make-a-group button'); const groupsBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().groups.map((group) => group.id); globalThis.__v2703.groupsBefore = groupsBefore; button.click(); const deadline = Date.now() + 10000; let ok = null; while (Date.now() < deadline && !ok) { ok = document.querySelector('dialog[open] .popup-button-ok'); if (!ok) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!ok) throw new Error('the make-a-group question never showed'); ok.click(); return { asked: true };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const deadline = Date.now() + 30000; while (Date.now() < deadline && !(ctx.groupId && globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId === 'sun-ruins')) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); const made = ctx.groups.find((group) => !globalThis.__v2703.groupsBefore.includes(group.id)); if (!made) throw new Error('no group was created'); globalThis.__v2703.made = made.id; const binding = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.groupStories?.[made.id]; const snapshot = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot(); const result = { group: made.name, members: made.members, open: ctx.groupId === made.id, binding, storyId: snapshot.storyId }; if (!result.open) throw new Error(`the new group was not opened: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (binding !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the new group is not bound to the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (made.members.length !== 4) throw new Error(`the group does not hold the story's whole cast: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (snapshot.storyId !== 'sun-ruins') throw new Error(`the new group chat does not play the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__v2703?.made; if (!id) return { cleaned: false, reason: 'no group was made' }; const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; if (root?.groupStories) delete root.groupStories[id]; const original = window.fetch; let answer = null; window.fetch = async (...args) => { const response = await original(...args); const url = new URL(String(args[0]?.url ?? args[0]), location.href); if (url.pathname === '/api/settings/save' && String(args[1]?.method ?? args[0]?.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase() === 'POST') answer = response.status; return response; }; try { const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); } finally { window.fetch = original; } if (!(answer >= 200 && answer < 300)) throw new Error(`the binding removal was not saved: /api/settings/save answered ${answer}`); const all = async () => (await fetch('/api/groups/all', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: '{}' })).json(); const remove = () => fetch('/api/groups/delete', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id }) }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); let response = await remove(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); let resurrected = false; if ((await all()).some((group) => String(group.id) === String(id))) { resurrected = true; response = await remove(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); } if ((await all()).some((group) => String(group.id) === String(id))) throw new Error(`the created group ${id} is still on the server after delete`); const { getGroups } = await import('/scripts/group-chats.js'); await getGroups(); return { deleted: response.ok, group: id, settingsSave: answer, resurrected };
